'''Version 1.8.1''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on August 3rd 2020.  It was 5.32 MB.

== ''Change Log'' ==

* Fixed crash caused by hitting a [[Primitive Longarms|Primitive]]/[[Adapted Longarms]]
* Changed description for "Block Infestation Cooldown"/"Block Light Level"
* Parasites spawned from the [[Evolution System#Functionality|merge system]] will no longer despawn
* Changed "RS Block Light Level" default value from 4 to 15
* [[Assimilated Human|Infected Humans]]/[[Assimilated Villager|Villagers]] spawned by a [[Rupter]] can now have other textures
* Fixed griefing task not being read in seconds
